title: Legacy ↔ Modern Public Integration Contract
purpose: Integrate older substantial readers with the newer Potato of Life / House / Rooms architecture without rewriting historical source strata, creating duplicate knowledge owners, or forcing every page into one visual template.
master_rule: Preserve old pages as authored/documentary strata where they still carry unique value; integrate them through generated public context, authoritative routing, shared capabilities and canonical-owner links.

layers.role: Original or historically evolved HTML/content remains the authored/source stratum.
layers.rule: Do not rewrite merely to make it look new when its content and specialist identity remain valuable.

layers.role: Build-time transforms add current navigation, House context, TTS, ontology fixes and other shared reader capabilities.
layers.rule: Projection may improve access and context but must not silently alter substantive historical claims.

layers.role: Registered surfaces show Potato → House → parent gateway → current surface plus feeding Dwellings/Rooms.
layers.rule: House context explains where a page lives; it does not make House the fact owner.

layers.role: Old prose points outward to the current canonical record when a durable concept now has a stronger owner.
layers.rule: Keep historical wording in place when useful; do not maintain a second current definition inside the old page.

layers.role: Mature legacy subjects may become registered Views/Guides over existing Rooms.
layers.rule: A View can be first-class publicly without becoming a new Room or knowledge owner.

layers.role: A legacy page may eventually redirect or archive when it contains no unique reader, historical or specialist value.
layers.rule: Retire only after unique information, inbound routes and provenance are safely migrated.

integration_sequence: classify the old page: source stratum, specialist View, duplicate projection, compatibility route or obsolete shell
identify its canonical parent gateway and feeding Dwellings/Rooms
register mature public surfaces in data/house/public-surfaces.json
mirror route topology in the checked public-route projection
attach relevant nested Rooms through room dossiers
project shared House bridge and reader capabilities at build time
replace duplicate current definitions with links to canonical owners where practical
preserve page-specific voice, layout and specialist tools
validate one route, one parent, one House bridge and no duplicate owner
only then consider pruning or redirecting older shells

page_classes.action: Preserve as provenance; add context externally rather than rewriting the historical record.
Regenerate from current canonical data; do not hand-maintain duplicate facts.
Redirect to the current canonical public surface while preserving discoverability.
Retire after verifying no unique content, references or capabilities remain.

shared_public_context.breadcrumb: Potato of Life → House → parent gateway (when applicable) → current surface
shared_public_context.local_context: Show the most relevant nested Rooms when the Room dossiers explicitly project to that surface; otherwise show feeding top-level Dwellings.
shared_public_context.boundary: Navigation and placement metadata are explanatory context, never evidence for substantive claims.

anti_patterns: copying new House explanations manually into dozens of old pages
rewriting historical pages until their original development is no longer reconstructable
creating a new canonical master because an old page uses different vocabulary
forcing World Map, Bible comparator, longform readers and static guides into identical layouts
using legacy status as a reason to hide a uniquely valuable specialist reader
keeping an obsolete shell public after its content and route have been fully replaced

first_integrated_legacy_views.classification: living-specialist House depth View over Archive/World/Culture/Research
